adiabatic_audit.interpretation: Mode response ratios compare diagnosed interface buoyancy from cell thermodynamics with the shared linear mode adiabat. Uniform-density symmetry cancels directional bias; stratified density retains first-order one-sided error. Refinement reduces both, not a fitted correction or Earth accuracy.

passive.limitations: Sequential dry wind generation and fixed-wind passive moisture; no phase, thermal/momentum feedback, radiation or Earth climate integration.

moist.limits: Fixed generated winds, shallow8km warm/supercooled liquid-only column, no ice/radiation/momentum feedback; not a full Earth column.
